newsitem.title: GREECE: XIOSBANK HAS AUTO LOANS APPROVED IN 15 MIN.
newsitem.headline: XIOSBANK HAS AUTO LOANS APPROVED IN 15 MIN.

text.p: Clients of Greek Xiosbank will know whether their auto loan applications have been approved or not in a short period of 15 minutes, it said in a statement.
"Now, the consumer will be in a position to know whether the loan has been approved within 15 minutes from the time an application is submitted," it said.
More than 10,500 Greek consumers have taken advantage of the XiosAuto plan to buy a car and the bank has loaned out a total of 25 billion drachmas, it added.

Its base business credit rate will remain steady at 19.75 percent for the week starting November 11 and the XiosAlma deposit account will offer an annual yield of 12.40 percent. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
